takeaways: Every-game spread picks went 9-5. Most are tiny gaps, so about half is expected.
Best prop type this season: Anytime TD, Over (45-128, +28.35 units). These are long-shot odds, so a few hits swing the total. Likely luck at this sample.
Weakest: Rushing yards, Over (77-99, -30.20 units). Worth avoiding until it turns.
Closing lines: 1 picks beat the close, 1 were worse, 12 didn't move.
Rushing yards: overs hit only 43.9% at the model's fair line (337 graded). The model runs high here, so unders have an edge.
